title: Character from an image, walking with the Mannequin animations
prompt: Generate a 3D character from the image {bench}/assets/character_tpose.png (a figure in a T pose) with mesh_generate, 180 cm tall, imported as {root}/SM_Hero. Rig it with auto_rig as the skeletal mesh {root}/SKM_Hero, retarget the template Mannequin's walk (/Game/Characters/Mannequins/Anims/Unarmed/Walk/MF_Unarmed_Walk_Fwd) onto it, and place it in the level as a SkeletalMeshActor labelled Hero that loops the retargeted walk.

scene.name: loops a walk retargeted to its skeleton
scene.expr: (lambda a: a is not None and 'Walk' in a.get_name() and a.get_skeleton() == asset('{root}/SKM_Hero').get_editor_property('skeleton'))(find('Hero').get_editor_property('skeletal_mesh_component').get_editor_property('animation_data').get_editor_property('anim_to_play'))
